detailZones.title: Campus entry
detailZones.description: Follow the gate, walkway, brick posts and planted entry court.

detailZones.title: Classroom detail
detailZones.description: Inspect the teaching wall, desk storage, globe stand and floor.

detailZones.title: Library and office detail
detailZones.description: Explore book rows, reading furniture, stairs and office hardware.

detailZones.title: Art studio detail
detailZones.description: Study the easel frames, paint containers, carts and bicycle rack.

detailZones.title: Music room detail
detailZones.description: Follow the piano, guitar, drum and stand hardware in rehearsal space.

detailZones.title: Gym and washroom detail
detailZones.description: Inspect sports hardware, mats, ball storage and washroom fixtures.

detailZones.title: School infirmary detail
detailZones.description: Explore the examination bed, privacy fittings and medical storage.

detailZones.title: Corridor and lockers detail
detailZones.description: Inspect locker vents, label slots, the notice board and cabinet seams.

detailZones.title: Equipment and preparation room detail
detailZones.description: Follow storage edges, bins, sink hardware and office-machine controls.

detailZones.title: South campus grounds detail
detailZones.description: Trace the path-light cap and hedge top along the planted grounds.

anchorAudit.rationale: The resized school-campus photograph was inspected at source and final pixels. This batch retains only 73 independently pointable fixture or part details across classrooms, library, arts, music, gym, infirmary, lockers, preparation rooms and planted grounds; all 73 display terms are new to the existing 43-scene world and the atlas school panel vocabulary. Student activities, signage, writing, medical procedures, hidden equipment functions and generic duplicate furniture were excluded.
